name: Spain
sources: Inflation 6.7% (INE CPI 1990); Banco de Espana intervention rate near 14.8% defending the peseta inside the ERM narrow band from June 1989.
Defence 1.8% of GDP: NATO member from 1982, outside the integrated command until 1999.
Separatism 0.18 is ETA plus Basque and Catalan autonomy politics under the 1978 constitution.
Debt 43% of GDP and tax take 33% of GDP (Banco de Espana / OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990). Oil 0.02 mbd is the residual Ayoluengo field and Mediterranean offshore output.
